answer: Each identity must keep an opal, a non-transferable deposit that grows with its funding cluster: wallets traced to one money source form a nebula, and the k-th member of a nebula must lock k squared POA, so n fakes cost about n cubed over three. Every week a tide of random cross-audits pairs agents from different nebulae to redo each other's work, and one failed audit drains every opal in that cluster, not just one.
